annotations.title: Get a download URL for one artifact

description: Mints a short-lived signed URL for one sealed artifact. Fetch it yourself with a plain GET and no headers; it expires. Example: {"run_id": "…", "artifact_id": "…"}. Returns {url, expires_at, media_type, digest, size_bytes, kind}. Cite the digest. Artifact ids come from run_artifacts. Do not use this to read a few rows — query_run is the cheaper answer.
name: get_artifact_download
title: Get a download URL for one artifact
